Aria Park: Hi all! Aria here — joining from Oakland, mostly remote but planning to come into SF once a week. I code infra stuff and I make terrible synthwave playlists. Also big ramen nerd. :ramen:
Samir Khan: Welcome Aria!! :tada: where in Oakland? we should grab a ramen run when you’re in town.
Aria Park: Thanks Samir! West Oakland — easy BART. Favorite spots so far: Ichiran (late-night) and this tiny spot in Emeryville with perfect shoyu.
Lina M.: hello and welcome! curious: morning coffee or tea? and any desk plant requests? we have a limited stash of succulents and a very opinionated fiddle-leaf. :seedling:
Aria Park: Coffee please (black). Plant: I can try to keep a pothos alive. No peanut snacks though — allergic.
Oliver G.: ayyyy synthwave + ramen, signed. welcome! also FYI the office fridge has a mystery jar of pickled garlic that killed three interns last winter. label your stuff. :grimacing:
DevEx Bot: @Aria Park — onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/onboarding/aria (account setup, vpn, seat reservation link). If you need a laptop or office key, ping #people-ops.
Samir Khan: quick poll: snack preference for welcome desk basket? react with emoji to vote: :bagel: for bagels, :cookie: cookies, :apple: fruit, :popcorn: savory popcorn.
Aria Park: I voted :bagel: (secretly hoping for everything).
Lina M.: welcome again!! also we do a monthly board game night — synthwave playlist would get added to the queue. :musical_note:
Oliver G.: if you make a playlist, I will defend it in the #random channel. :muscle:
Aria Park: ok I'm in. playlist coming. thanks everyone for the warm welcome — excited to be here!
